description: What the feeds covering a topic have actually published lately, newest first — the river rather than the roster. Note the difference from get_topic, which lists who covers the subject; this lists what they wrote. Drawn from the feeds most strongly filed under the topic, so a very broad keyword is a sample rather than a census. A comma-separated list ("business, saas, crypto", up to 10) is one river across all of them.

keyword.description: The topic, in any spelling — or several, separated by commas.

name: topic_posts
title: Recent posts on a topic
